Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax with ipsilateral mediastinal shift (trachea and heart deviated to the left), which indicates volume loss consistent with left lung collapse. The accompanying CT scan confirms a large central mass obstructing the left main bronchus, leading to total left lung atelectasis (collapse).
